instruction: Add a hyperlink to the text 'Learn More' on the first slide that points to 'https://example.com/info'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding a hyperlink to specific text on first slide. Evaluator checks: (1) First slide contains text 'Learn More' (0.5 points), (2) That text has a hyperlink to 'https://example.com/info' (0.5 points). Verified by parsing slide XML for hyperlink relationships.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic issue: Lines 54-60 in impress.py extract URLs from XML but set 'text' to empty string, creating incomplete hyperlink entries that won't match expected text

Metric matching is too flexible: Lines 26-29 in slides.py use substring matching ('expected_text in link_text', 'expected_url in link_url') which would incorrectly match partial URLs like 'https://example.com/info/more' or text containing 'Learn More' as substring

Partial credit logic flaw: Metric awards 0.5 points if text 'Learn More' exists anywhere in hyperlinks list (line 33-34), even if that text comes from an incomplete XML-parsed entry with empty text field, not verifying text is actually hyperlinked
Redundant extraction approaches: Getter uses both manual ZIP/XML parsing (incomplete) and python-pptx library (correct), potentially adding duplicate or inconsistent entries to the hyperlinks list
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Remove the manual ZIP/XML parsing approach (lines 30-60) and rely solely on python-pptx library (lines 63-74) which correctly extracts both text and URL
Change metric matching to exact comparison: Use 'link_text.strip() == expected_text' and 'link_url.strip() == expected_url' instead of substring matching to prevent false positives
Fix partial credit logic to ensure text match only counts when the text is actually part of a hyperlink (not an empty-text entry from XML parsing)
Add validation in getter to filter out hyperlink entries with empty text fields before returning the result
